name: batch-scrape-status-ok
description: A direct read of a completed batch scrape job - the second chunk, reached with ?skip=2. Carries the WHOLE JOB's creditsUsed (3), which is exactly the trap: inheriting the provider's vendor-claim consolidate here would re-bill the entire job on every read. The endpoint is FREE and overrides it to an empty claim. The url is LITERAL rather than a {{request.url}} binding because the engine substitutes {id} before the call, so the two job-read endpoints diverge once bound and cannot share one chain.
